verses.text: Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaje kuri Hoseya mwene Beyeri igihe abami Uziya, Yotamu, Ahazi na Hezekiya, bakurakuranwa ku ngoma i Buyuda, Yerobowamu mwene Yowashi na we ari umwami w’Abisirayeli:

Igihe Uhoraho yatangura kuvugisha Hoseya, yamubwiye ati: “Genda urongore umugore w’umumaraya, kugira ngo uvyarane na we abana, kuko kurya umugore w’umusambanyi ahemuka, ni ko n’iki gihugu cahemukiye Uhoraho mu gusenga ibigirwamana.”
Nuko Hoseya aragenda arongora Gomeri, umukobwa wa Dibulayimu, asama inda avyarana na we umuhungu.
Maze Uhoraho abwira Hoseya, ati: “Mwite Yezireyeli, kuko nzohana vuba ubwami bukomoka kuri Yehu kubera ubwicanyi yakoreye i Yezireyeli, nongere ndandure n’ubwami bwa Isirayeli.
Kuri uwo musi nzovuna umuheto ari zo nkomezi za Isirayeli mu kiyaya c’i Yezireyeli.”
Gomeri yongera gusama inda avyara umukobwa. Uhoraho abwira Hoseya ati: “Mwite Lo-Ruhama, kuko ntazokwongera gukunda inzu ya Isirayeli, ngo ndabaharire na gatoya.
Ariko nzokunda inzu ya Yuda; kandi nzobakiza ntabakirishije umuheto, inkota canke intambara, canke amafarasi canke abagendera ku mikogote, ariko Jewe Uhoraho Imana yabo nzobakiza.”
Amaze gucutsa Lo-Ruhama, Gomeri arongera asama inda, avyara uwundi muhungu.
Maze Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Mwite Lo-Ami, kuko Isirayeli ntimuri abantu banje, kandi nanje sindi Imana yanyu.

Ariko Abisirayeli bazoba nk’umusenyi wo kw’isesero ry’ikiyaga, udashobora guharurwa canke gupimwa. Kandi mu kibanza babwiriwemwo ngo: ‘Ntimuri abantu banje,’ ni ho bazobwirirwa ngo: ‘Muri abana b’Imana Nzima.’
Abantu ba Yuda n’abantu ba Isirayeli bazosubira kuja hamwe, bashireho umuntu umwe wo kubarongora kandi bazosohoka bave mu gihugu barimwo nk’inyagano, kuko uwo musi wa Yezireyeli uzoba umusi uhambaye.
Kuri uwo musi, muzokwita abavukanyi banyu: ‘Bantu banje,’ na bashiki banyu: ‘Bakundwa banje.’
Ihanize nyoko wawe, mwihanize, kuko ntakiri umugore wanje, kandi nanje sinkiri umugabo wiwe. Niyiyambure ibimenyetso vy’ubusambanyi mu maso hiwe hamwe n’ivy’ubuhemu mu mabere yiwe.
Bitabaye uko nzomwambura impuzu asigare ari gusa; nzomusiga uko yaremwe, nk’uko yari ku musi w’amavuka; nzomugira nk’ubugaragwa, nzomuhindura nk’isi yumye, ndamwicishe inyota.
Sinzokwereka urukundo abana biwe, kuko ari abana bavuye mu busambanyi.

Nyina wabo yarampemukiye aba maraya, kandi yabatwaye inda mu buryo buteye isoni. Yaravuze ati: ‘Nzokurikira abo nikundiye, bampa ivyokurya n’amazi, impuzu z’ubwoya n’izera derere nziza, bampa amavuta ya elayo n’ivyo kunywa.’
Nuko rero nzozibiza inzira yiwe amahwa; nzomwubakira uruzitiro abure inzira.

Azokurikira abo akunda ariko ntazobashikira; azobarondera ariko ntazobabona. Maze mu nyuma azovuga ati: ‘Reka nsubire ku mugabo wanje wa mbere, kuko igihe nari nkiri kumwe na we nari merewe neza kurusha ubu.’
Ntiyigeze amenya ko ari jewe namuha ingano, umuvinyu musha n’amavuta ya elayo, nkamusukako ifeza n’inzahabu; ivyo baca bakoresha mu gushikanira Bayali.
Ni co gituma nzotwara ingano zanje mw’iyimbura ryazo, n’umuvinyu musha wanje mu gihe cawo. Nzotwara impuzu zanje z’ipampa n’izera derere nziza, ivyo nari namuhaye ngo ahishe ubwambure bwiwe.
Ni co gituma ngiye gushira ahabona ibiterasoni vyiwe, imbere y’amaso y’abo yikundira; nta n’umwe azomunkura mu maboko.
Nzoshira iherezo ku misi mikuru yiwe yose: imisi mikuru y’umwaka, iy’imboneko z’ukwezi, n’iy’amasabato yiwe, imisi mikuru yiwe yose yashinzwe.
Nzoherengeteza imizabibu n’imisukoni yiwe, ivyo yavuze ko ari impembo yahawe n’abo yikundiye; nzohahindura nk’igisaka, kandi ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bizoza kukirisha.
Nzomuhanira imisi yamaze aturirira ibimota neza Bayali; akisakara ivyo kwishariza vyose vy’impeta n’utubuyenge, maze akiruka inyuma y’abo yikundiye, ariko jewe akanyibagira,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Naho biri uko, ubu ngiye kumwiyegereza; ndamujane mu bugaragwa ndamuganirize n’ubugwaneza.

Aho ni ho nzomusubiriza ya mizabibu yiwe, kandi nzohindura ca kiyaya ca Akori c’imibabaro gicike umuryango ujana mu vyizigiro. Aho ni ho azokwongera kunyishikanira nk’uko yari yarabikoze kera mu misi yo mu buto bwiwe, ca gihe namubohora ari mu buja bwa Egiputa.
Kuri uwo musi, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uzompamagara uti: ‘Mugabo wanje!’ Ntuzosubira kumpamagara ngo: ‘Databuja!’
Nzokura mu kanwa kiwe amazina ya za Bayali; kandi amazina yazo ntazosubira kwambazwa.

Kuri uwo musi nzosezerana isezerano ku bwabo nsezerane n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, n’inyoni zo mu kirere hamwe n’ibikwega inda kw’isi kugira ngo ntibigire ico bibagira. Umuheto n’inkota n’intambara nzobikura mu gihugu, kugira ngo bose bashobore kuryama mu mutekano.
Nzokwiyegereza umbere umugore w’ibihe bidashira; nzokwiyegerezanya ubugororotsi n’ubutungane, mfise urukundo n’impuhwe.
Nzokwiyegerezanya ubwizigirwa, nawe amaherezo uzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .
Kuri uwo musi nzokwishura, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, nzokwishura amajuru asaba ibicu, na yo azokwishura isi isaba imvura;
maze isi na yo izokwishura ingano, umuvinyu musha n’amavuta, na vyo bizokwishura Yezireyeli.
Nzomuteragira mu gihugu abe uwanje; nzokwereka urukundo uwo nabwiye nti: ‘Sindagukunda.’ Abo nita ngo: ‘Si abantu banje’ nzobabwira nti: ‘Muri abantu banje’; na bo bazovuga bati: ‘Uri Imana yacu.’ ”

headings.text: Uguhanwa kwa Isirayeli no gusubira kubabarirwa

verses.text: Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Genda, usubire wereke urukundo umugore wawe, naho akundwa n’uwundi mugabo kandi akaba umusambanyikazi. Umukunde nk’uko Uhoraho akunda Abisirayeli, naho bahindukirira izindi mana bagakunda udutsima tubumbiwe izo mana mu nzabibu.”
Nuko ndamugura shekeli cumi na zitanu z’ifeza n’ingero homeru na leteki vya sayiri.
Hanyuma nca ndamubwira nti: “Uzobana nanje imisi myinshi; ntuzosubire kuba maraya canke ngo wongere kuryamana n’uwundi mugabo n’umwe, nanje nzobana nawe gutyo nyene.”
Ni ukuvuga ko Abisirayeli bazobaho imisi myinshi ata mwami canke umuganwa bafise, ata bimazi canke inkingi, ata efodi canke ibigirwamana.
Inyuma y’ivyo Abisirayeli bazogaruka biyegurire Uhoraho Imana yabo no kuri Dawidi umwami wabo. Kandi mu misi ya nyuma, bazoza k’ Uhoraho no ku migisha yiwe bahindishwa agashitsi no kugira neza kwiwe.
Nimwumve Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe Bisirayeli, kuko Uhoraho afise urubanza aburana na mwebwe muba muri iki gihugu: “Nta bwizigirwa bukiriho, nta rukundo, nta kumenya Imana bikiri muri iki gihugu.
Hasigaye hari umuvumo, ukubesha n’ubwicanyi, ukwiba n’ugusambana; umuryano ukwiye hose, kandi ugusesa amaraso ni urutavanako.
Ni kubera ivyo igihugu cose kigandaye, kandi abakibamwo bose bakaba bariko barahona; mbere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, inyoni zo mu kirere n’amafi yo mu kiyaga biriko birahona.
Ariko ntihagire uwagiriza uwundi, ntihagire uwutuma urutoke uwundi, kuko abo kwagirizwa ni mwebwe abaherezi.
Mutsitara ku murango no mw’ijoro, kandi n’abavugishwa banyu b’ibinyoma batsitarana namwe. Ni co gituma nzokwica nyoko.

Abantu banje bishwe no kutamenya. Kuko mwebwe abaherezi mwanse kumenya, nanje nanse ko muba abaherezi banje; kandi kuko mwirengagije kumenya ivyagezwe vy’Imana yanyu, nanje nzokwirengagiza guhezagira abana banyu.
Uko abaherezi baba benshi, ni ko barushaho kuncumurako; bakavye ubwiza bw’Imana yabo babusubiriza ibiteye isoni vy’ibigirwamana.
Kuko abaherezi barya ibivuye mu vyaha vy’abantu banje nta kindi bipfuza atari kubona abantu banje bacumura!
Kandi ibikorwa n’abaherezi, ni vyo n’abantu basanzwe bakora. Nzohana abo bose kubera izo nzira zabo ndabasubirize mu nkoko ivyo bakoze.
Bazorya, ariko ntibazohaga; bazoja mu busambanyi ariko nta co bazokwunguka, kuko bataye Uhoraho bakiyegurira
ubusambanyi, no kunywa umuvinyu wa kera na mushasha, bigatwara ugutahura kwabo.
Abantu banje basiguza ikigirwamana c’igiti maze bakiyumvira ko inkoni ishobora kubabwira ivya kazoza. Impwemu y’ubusambanyi irabazimiza; bagata ubwizigirwa bakava ku Mana yabo.

Batangira ibimazi ku dutwe tw’imisozi bagaturirira ibimota neza ku dusozi, musi y’ibiti vy’imyeloni, n’imilebeni, n’imyelayo, kuko igitutu cavyo ari ciza. Ni co gituma abakobwa banyu baba abamaraya, abakazana banyu na bo bakiha ubusambanyi.

Mbega ni kuki nohana abakobwa banyu kubera ubumaraya bwabo, canke abakazana banyu kubera ubusambanyi bwabo? Abagabo banyu ubwabo bihereranya abamaraya kandi batangira ibimazi hamwe n’abamaraya. Abantu badatahura bazohona!

Naho wewe Isirayeli uri maraya, ntutume Yuda na we yagirwa n’ico caha. Ntukaje i Gilugali gusenga ibigirwamana; canke ngo uje i Beti-Aveni, kandi ntukarahire mw’izina ryanje ngo: ‘Ni ukuri nk’ukubaho kw’ Uhoraho !’
Abisirayeli bakomantaje imitima, babaye nk’inka y’ikigaba. None Uhoraho yobaragira ate nk’uwuragira imyagazi y’intama mu bwatsi bwiza?
Efurayimu yifatanije n’ibigirwamana; nimumureke!
N’igihe ibinyobwa vyabo biheze, bibandaniriza ubumaraya bwabo; abatware babo bakunda inzira z’ibiteterwe kurusha iz’icubahiro.
Agashururu kazobakubura; n’ibimazi vyabo baha ibigirwamana bizobamaramaza.

Nimwumve ibi, yemwe baherezi! Nimutege amatwi, yemwe Bisirayeli! Nimwumvirize, yemwe abo mu nzu y’abami! Uru ni rwo rubanza muciriwe: Kuko mwabaye umutego i Misipa, n’urusenga rutezwe hejuru ya Tabori.
Abagarariji bashitse kure mu kwica. Nzobahana bose.
Ndazi ivya Efurayimu vyose; Abisirayeli ntibahishijwe mu nyonga hanje. Efurayimu, wahindukiriye ubumaraya; Isirayeli yarahumanye.
Ivyo bakoze ntibibemerera kugaruka ku Mana yabo. Impwemu y’ubumaraya iri mu mitima yabo; ntibashobora kumenya Uhoraho .
Ubwibone bw’Abisirayeli ni bwo bubagiriza; Abisirayeli, mbere n’Abefurayimu, batsitara ku vyaha vyabo; Abayuda na bo nyene batsitara hamwe na bo.
Nibaja kurondera Uhoraho bitwaje imikuku yabo n’amasho vyabo ntibazomubona; kuko yitandukanije na bo.
Ntibabaye abizigirwa k’ Uhoraho ; bavyaye abana batari ab’isezerano. None rero imisi mikuru y’imboneko z’ukwezi yabo izokwonona imirima yabo.
Nimuvugirize inzamba i Gibeya, n’ihembe risamirane i Rama. Nimwihe akamo k’intambara i Beti-Aveni; nuje imbere yewe Benyamini.
Efurayimu hazosigara ari amatongo ku musi wo guhanwa. Mu miryango y’Abisirayeli nzovuga ivy’ukuri.
Abatware ba Yuda bameze nka ba bandi bashingura akarimbi. Nzobasukako uburake bwanje kurya kw’isuri y’amazi.
Efurayimu barasiribanzwe, barahonyanzwe mu rubanza, kuko bashimye gukurikira ibigirwamana.
Nzomera nk’igihute gihiye kuri Efurayimu, nk’igikomere casebuye kuri Yuda.

Igihe Efurayimu abonye ingwara yiwe, na Yuda akabona igihute ciwe, Efurayimu yaciye ahindukirira Ashuri, atuma intumwa ku mwami waho akomeye ngo amutabare. Ariko ntashobora kubavura, ntashobora gukiza ibihute vyabo.
Nzoba nk’intambwe kuri Efurayimu, nzoba nk’intambwe ikomye kuri Yuda. Nzobatabagura maze nigire; nzobajana bose, kandi nta n’umwe azoshobora kubatabara.
Maze nzosubira ahantu hanje kugeza aho bazokwemerera icaha cabo. Maze bakarondera mu nyonga hanje; mu magorwa yabo bazondondeza imitima yabo yose.”
“Nimuze, dusubire k’ Uhoraho . Yaradutabaguye ariko ni we azodukiza; yaradukomerekeje ariko ni we azotenga ibikomere vyacu.
Inyuma y’imisi ibiri azoduhembura; ku musi ugira gatatu azotunagura, kugira ngo tube mu nyonga ziwe.
Nimuze tumenye Uhoraho ; tugire umwete wo kumumenya. Nk’uko izuba ata coribuza guseruka, ni ko azoseruka; azotuzako kurya imvura y’urushana igwa, kurya imvura y’agatasi ivomera isi.”
Mbega Efurayimu ndakugire nte? Nokugira gute ga Yuda? Urukundo rwawe rumeze nk’igipfungu co mu gatondo, kurya kw’ikime co mu gitondo gikamangana mu kanya gatoya izuba riserutse.
Ni co gituma nagutemaguje abavugishwa banje, nkakwicisha amajambo yo mu kanwa kanje; imanza zanje zarasiye kuri wewe nk’izuba.
Kuko nshaka ko mugira imbabazi, kuruta kumpa ibimazi, n’ukumenya Imana kuruta ibimazi vyoshejwe.
Ariko, mwarenze kw’isezerano nka Adamu, ntimwambera abizigirwa.
Gileyadi ni igisagara c’inkozi z’ibibi, candujwe n’ibirenge vyakandagiye mu maraso.
Nk’uko ibisuma bibundira uwo bigomba kwiba, ni ko n’utugwi tw’abaherezi tumeze; bagandagurira abantu ku nzira ija i Shekemu, bagakora ibibi biteye isoni.
Narabonye ikintu giteye ubwoba muri Isirayeli, aho Efurayimu yitanze ngo ahinduke maraya, Isirayeli akihumanya.
Kandi nawe Yuda, hari iyimbura rikurindiriye. Igihe nzogarukana abantu banje bajanywe ari imbohe.
Igihe cose nzokiza Abisirayeli, ivyaha vya Efurayimu bizoshirwa ahabona, n’ibibi vya Samariya bihishurwe. Bakora ivyo kubesha, abasuma bamena amazu, abambuzi na bo bakiba bari mu mabarabara;
ariko ntibamenye ko nibuka ibikorwa vyabo bibi vyose bakora. Ivyaha vyabo birabatwikiriye; vyama imbere yanje imisi yose.
Banezereza umwami n’ibibi vyabo, n’abaganwa mu vyo bababesha.
Bose ni abasambanyi, bashuha nk’ifuru uwotsa imikate adakeneye kwongera kwatsa, iguma ishushe kugeza igikandu c’ifu gikakamye.
Ku musi wo kwigina umwami wacu abaganwa barengerwa n’umuvinyu, maze umwami agafatana amaboko n’abamucokora.
Imitima yabo ishuha nk’ifuru y’imikate; bamwegerana uruhendo. Ishavu ryabo riba riryamye ijoro ryose; mu gitondo rikavyuka kurya kw’umuriro utongora.
Bose barashushe nk’ifuru y’imikate; bashihagura abatware babo. Kandi abami babo bose baratembagajwe ariko nta n’umwe anyambaza.
Efurayimu yivanze n’amahanga; Efurayimu ameze nk’umukate utahindukijwe mu kwotswa.
Abanyamahanga bamaze inkomezi ziwe, ariko nta vyo abona. Umushatsi wiwe wahindutse imvi, ariko nta na kimwe azi.
Ubwishime bwa Isirayeli ni bwo bubagiriza, ariko naho bimeze uko ntahindukirira Uhoraho Imana yiwe canke ngo amurondere.
Efurayimu ameze nk’inuma, y’ikijuju itazi iyo ija, batabaza Egiputa, hanyuma bagahindukirira Ashuri.
Bakigendayo, nzobatererako urusenga rwanje; nzobatsinda hasi nk’inyoni zo mu kirere. Igihe nzobumva bariko bariyegeranya, nzobafata.
Baragowe, kuko bazimiye bakaja kure yanje! Uguhona kurabashitseko, kuko bangararije! Ndipfuza kubacungura ariko bavuga ibinyoma kuri jewe!
Ntibantakambira bivuye mu mitima yabo, ariko baborogera ku mariri yabo. Bakoranira hamwe gusaba imana z’amahanga basaba ingano n’umuvinyu musha ariko bakanja kure.
Narabigishije kandi ndabakomeza, ariko bangiriye inama mbi.
Ntibahindukiriye Iyisumbavyose; bameze nk’umuheto ugoramye. Abatware babo bazokwicwa n’inkota ku bw’amajambo yabo y’ubweruzi. Kubera ivyo bazocokorwa bari mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Shira inzamba ku munwa! Umwansi amanutse nk’inkona ku nzu y’ Uhoraho kuko abantu barenze kw’isezerano ryanje bakagarariza ivyagezwe vyanje.
Abisirayeli barantakambira bavuga bati: “Ewe Mana, turakwemeye!”
Ariko Isirayeli yataye ivyari vyiza; nuko rero umwansi azomuhiga.
Biyimikiye abami batangishije inama; batoranije abaganwa ntabahaye uruhusha. Bakoresha ifeza n’inzahabu vyabo mu gucura ibigirwamana bizotuma bahona.
Yewe Samariya, terera kure ikigirwamana cawe c’inyana! Uburake bwanje burarurumvye kubera vyo. Uzogeza ryari kugendera mu bidatunganye?
Umwisirayeli ni we yakubumbiye iyo nyana, ariko ni jewe Mana jenyene. None rero izomenagurwa, ijanjagurike, iyo nyana y’i Samariya.
“Babivye umuyaga, bazokwimbura agashururu. Ingano zabo nta ntete ziriko; ntizizovamwo ifu. Naho zokwera imbuto, abanyamahanga ni bo bazozirira.
Abisirayeli baramizwe; ubu iyo bari mu mahanga bameze nk’inkono itagira ikimazi.
Kuko baduze bakaja muri Ashuri, bagiye kurya kw’indogoba yo mw’ishamba yangara yonyene. Efurayimu yishoye ku bandi bagabo yikundiye.
Naho bishoye mu mahanga bakifatanya na benshi, ngiye kubegeraniriza hamwe ndabacire urubanza. Bazoremerwa cane bari musi y’agacinyizo k’umwami ahambaye.
Naho Efurayimu yubatse ibicaniro vyinshi vyo gutanga ibimazi vy’ivyaha, vyahindutse ibicaniro vyo gukora ivyaha.
Nabandikiye vyinshi mu vyagezwe vyanje, ariko babiravye nk’ikintu c’icaduka.
Naho batanga ibimazi nk’ishikanwa bampaye, kandi naho baheza bakarya inyama, Uhoraho ntibamuhimbara. Ubu nzokwibuka ibibi vyabo ndabahanire ivyaha vyabo: bazosubira muri Egiputa.
Abisirayeli bibagiye Umuremyi wabo maze bubaka ibirimba bihambaye; Abayuda bakomeje ibisagara vyabo. Ariko nzotuma umuriro ku bisagara vyabo uzotongora iminara yabo.”
Ntunezerwe, Isirayeli; ntutwarwe n’akanyamuneza nk’ayandi mahanga. Kuko wahemukiye Imana yawe; ugakunda ingero igererwa maraya usenga ibigirwamana ku mbuga yose yo kugosorerako.
Ku bw’ivyo, imbuga zo kugosorerako n’amato yo kuganiramwo ntibizoshobora kugaburira abantu; umutobe musha nta wo bazobona.
Ntimuzoguma mu gihugu c’ Uhoraho ; Efurayimu azosubira muri Egiputa kandi azorya ivyokurya bihumanye vyo muri Ashuri.

Ntibazosukira Uhoraho ishikanwa ry’umuvinyu, canke ngo ibimazi vyabo bimuhimbare. Ibimazi nk’ivyo bizobabera nk’ivyokurya vy’abagandaye; abazobirya bose bazoba bahumanye. Ivyo ni vyo bizoba ivyokurya vyabo ubwabo; ntibizoza mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Mbega muzokora iki ku misi mikuru yanyu yashinzwe, ku misi mikuru y’ Uhoraho ?
Naho bokira gutikiza kwa Ashuri, Egiputa izobegeranya, Memfisi na yo izobahamba. Ubutunzi bwanyu bw’ifeza buzorengerwa n’imikere, amahwa na yo azomera mu mahema yanyu yasanganguwe.

Imisi yo guhana Isirayeli iraje, imisi yo kugerera umuntu iri hafi. Abisirayeli nimubimenye. Kuko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyinshi cane n’ubwansi bwanyu bukaba bwinshi. Uwuvugishwa n’Imana mumufata nk’ikijuju, kandi uwuhumekerwa nanje mumufata nk’umusazi.
Uwuvugishwa n’Imana ari kumwe n’Imana yanje, ni umuteramyi ateramiye Efurayimu, ariko mwamuteze imitego mu nzira ziwe acamwo, n’ubwansi mu nzu y’Imana yiwe.
Mwinjiye i bwina mu bibi, nko mu misi ya Gibeya. Imana izokwibuka ibibi vyabo, yongere ibahanire ivyaha vyabo.

“Aho natora Isirayeli, kwari nk’ugutora inzabibu mu bugaragwa; aho nabona ba sogokuruza banyu, kwari nk’ukubona ivyamwa vyeze imbere y’ibindi ku musukoni. Ariko bashitse i Bayali-Peyori, bifatanije na ca kigirwamana Bayali giteye isoni baca baba abo kwankwa urunuka nk’ico kintu bari bifatanije.
Ubwiza bwa Efurayimu buzoguruka nk’inyoni, nta kuvuka, nta gutwara inda, nta n’ugusama inda.
Kandi naho boronka abana, nzobahonya bose nta wuzosigara. Bazoba bagowe aho nzobaterera ibitugu!
Nabonye Efurayimu, hameze nk’i Tiro, hasharijwe nk’ahantu h’igikundiro. Ariko Efurayimu we azosohokana hanze abana biwe ngo batemagurwe.”
Ewe Uhoraho , bahe, mbega wobaha iki? Bahe inda zisamwa ariko zigakoroka n’amabere atagira amaberebere.
“Kubera ibibi vyabo vyose bakoreye i Gilugali, aho ni ho nabankiye. Kubera ibikorwa vyabo bibi, nzobasohora bamvire mu nzu. Sinzosubira kubakunda; abatware babo bose ni abagarariji.
Efurayimu ararashwe, imizi yiwe irakabiranye, kandi ntibazokwama ivyamwa. Naho bovyara abana, nzokwicisha inkota uruvyaro rwabo bakunda cane.”
Imana yanje izobaheba kuko batamwumviye; bazoba inyererezi mu mahanga.

Isirayeli yari uruzabibu rumeze neza; yamye ivyamwa vyiwe vyiza. Ariko, uko ivyamwa vyiwe vyagwira, ni ko yarushaho kwubaka ibicaniro vy’ibigirwamana; uko igihugu ciwe catera imbere, ni ko yarushaho gushariza inkingi z’amabuye yo gusengwa.
Imitima yabo iriyorobeka, kandi bagira biremeke ibigabitanyo vyabo. Uhoraho azosambura ibicaniro vyabo kandi azosangangura izo nkingi zabo.
Maze bazovuga bati: “Nta mwami tugira kuko tutubashe Uhoraho . Ariko kandi naho twari kuba dufise umwami, yari kutumarira iki?”
Basezerana amasezerano menshi, bakarahira indahiro z’ibinyoma kandi bakiyemeza vyinshi; ni co gituma urubanza rwabo rutanguye gukura nk’igiterwa gifise ubumara cadutse mu ndimiro.

Abantu baba i Samariya baratinya ivyoshikira ikigirwamana c’imasa c’i Beti-Aveni. Abantu baho bazokigandarira, kandi n’abaherezi baco ni uko, abari bahimbawe n’ugukayangana kwaco, kuko kizojanwa kw’inyagano kive muri bo.
Kizojanwa muri Ashuri kibe ingabire ihawe umwami mukuru. Efurayimu azoteterwa; Isirayeli amaramare ku bw’amasezerano yagize n’abanyamahanga.
Samariya n’umwami waho bazotikizwa, bakamangane nk’ifuro rireremba ku mazi.

Ibibanza vyo ku misozi miremire aho basengera ibigirwamana bizosamburwa, ni co caha ca Isirayeli. Amahwa n’imikere bizomera bikure birenge ku bicaniro vyaho. Maze bazobwira imisozi bati: “Duhambe!” n’imitumba bati: “Tugweko!”
Kuva mu misi ya Gibeya, wakoze ivyaha, yewe Isirayeli, kandi aho ni ho wagumye. Mbega intambara ntizosubira guhitana abanyakibi i Gibeya?
Aho bizompimbarira, nzobahana; amahanga azokoranywa no kubagwanya ngo abashire mu minyororo kubera ivyaha vyabo vyinshi.
Efurayimu ameze nk’ishashi yigishijwe igakunda gusekura ingano; none rero nzomwambika ingogo ku kazosi kiwe kagororotse. Nzokwega Efurayimu, Yuda azomena umushike, Yakobo na we azokangaza.

Nimwibibire ubugororotsi, kugira ngo muze mwimbure ivyamwa vy’urukundo rudashira, kandi mumene imishike ari yo mitima yanyu; kuko iki ari igihe co kurondera Uhoraho , kugeza aho azozira akabacuncuburirako imvura y’ubugororotsi.
Ariko mwabivye ubugarariji, mwimbura ibibi, mwariye ivyamwa vy’ibinyoma. Kuko mwizigiye inkomezi zanyu gusa n’inkomezi z’ingabo zanyu nyinshi,

ni co gituma akaruru k’intambara kazovyuka ku bw’abantu banyu, kugira ngo inzitiro zanyu zose zize zisangangurwe, nk’uko Shalumani yasanganguye Beti-Arubeli ku musi w’intambara, aho abagore bamenagurirwa hasi hamwe n’abana babo.
Ni ko bizoba kuri wewe, yewe Beteli, kuko ibibi vyawe ari vyinshi. Aho umutwenzi wo guhanwa uzotambikira, umwami wa Isirayeli azosangangurwa rwose.
Isirayeli akiri umwana, naramukunda, kandi nahamagaye umwana wanje ngo ave muri Egiputa.
Ariko uko nabahamagara, ni ko barushaho kuja kure yanje. Bashikaniye ibimazi za Bayali kandi baturirira ibimota neza ibishushanyo.
Ni jewe nigishije Efurayimu gutambuka, ndabafashe ukuboko; ariko ntibamenye ko ari jewe nabakijije ingwara.
Nabakwegesheje imigozi y’ukugira neza kw’abantu, n’imigozi y’urukundo. Nababereye nk’uwuterura akana gatoya akagakikira, kandi narunamye kugira ngo ndabagaburire.
Mbega ntibazosubira muri Egiputa, vyongeye Abashuri ntibazobaganza ko banse kwihana?
Inkota izoza ku bisagara vyabo; izorigata abavugishwa b’ibinyoma babo ishire kw’iherezo imigambi yabo.
Abantu banje bafashe ingingo yo kuntera ibitugu. Naho banyita Imana Musumbavyose, sinzokwigera ndabashira hejuru.
“Efurayimu we, mbega noguheba nte? Isirayeli we, mbega nogutanga gute? Mbega nokugirira nk’i Adima? Mbega nokugirira nka Zeboyimu? Umutima wanje urabuze ico uhitamwo; ntewe n’akagongwe.
Sinzobahanana uburake, kandi sinzosubira gusangangura Efurayimu. Kuko ndi Imana, ntari umuntu, Uwera ari muri mwebwe. Sinzotera ibisagara vyabo.
Kuko umusi umwe bazokurikira Uhoraho ; kandi nzokwivuga nk’intambwe. Aho nzokwivugira, abana biwe bazoza bahinda agashitsi bava mu burengero.
Bazoza bavuye muri Egiputa, bahinda agashitsi nk’inyoni, bavuye muri Ashuri, bameze nk’inuma. Nzobasubiza mu mazu yabo,” ni ko Uhoraho agize.
Efurayimu yankikije ibinyoma, Isirayeli na we yankikije uguhendana. Kandi Yuda yahindutse umugarariji ku Mana, ku Wera w’Umwizigirwa.
Efurayimu arya umuyaga; akurikira umuyaga uturutse mu buseruko rikarinda rirenga, akagwiza ibinyoma n’umuryano. Yagiriraniye amasezerano na Ashuri kandi yarungitse amavuta ya elayo muri Egiputa.
Uhoraho arafise ivyo yagiriza Abayuda; azohana Yakobo ibihuye n’inzira ziwe kandi azomwishura ibihwanye n’ibikorwa vyiwe.
Akiri mu nda yaniganye na mukuruwe amufashe igitsintsiri; amaze gukura naho anigana n’Imana.
Yaniganye n’umumarayika aratsinda; yararize asaba umuhezagiro. Aho i Beteli, yabonye Imana imbonankubone maze Imana ivuganira na we aho hantu.
Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe!
Nuko rero, ubu nimugaruke ku Mana mugumye urukundo n’uguca imanza zibereye, maze mwame mwiteze Imana yanyu imisi yose.
Ariko si uko biri, umudandaza akoresha iminzane ibesha agakunda inyungu mbi.
Efurayimu arishima ngo: Ndatunze cane; narironkeye ubutunzi. Nta woronka ico anyagiriza mu butunzi bwanje bwose nk’icaha canke kugabitanya.
Ariko, namye ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe kuva ukiva muri Egiputa; nzotuma usubira kuba mu mahema kandi, nka kurya kwo mu misi mikuru yawe yashinzwe.
Navuganye n’abavugishwa banje ndabagutumako, ntuma berekwa vyinshi ndakubwira mu migani myinshi ncishije muri bo.
Mbega ab’i Gileyadi ni abanyakibi? Abantu baho nta co bamaze! Mbega bashikanira ibimazi vyabo i Gilugali? Ibicaniro vyabo bizoba nk’ibirundo vy’amabuye biri mu busize.
Yakobo yahungiye mu gihugu ca Aramu, Isirayeli yarakoze ngo aronke umugore, kugira ngo amukwe yaragiye intama.
Uhoraho yakoresheje uwuvugishwa na we ngo adugane Isirayeli amukuye muri Egiputa, yakoresheje uwavugishwa na we ngo abe umwungere w’abantu biwe.
Ariko Efurayimu yamuteye uburake bw’inkazi; Umwami wiwe azomusubiza ku mutwe amaraso yasheshe kandi azomusubiriza mu nkoko ivyaha vyiwe.
Iyo Efurayimu avuze, abantu barajugumira; kuko yashizwe hejuru mu Bisirayeli. Ariko Abefurayimu baracumuye mu gusenga Bayali maze barapfa.

Ubu rero barushirijeho gukora ivyaha; bicurira ibigirwamana mw’ifeza zabo, bihinguriye mu bwenge bwabo ibishushanyo. Vyose ni ibikorwa vy’abacuzi. Ehe ibivugwa kuri abo bantu: “Batanga abantu kw’ibimazi! Bagasoma ibishushanyo vy’inka!”
Ni co gituma bazoba nk’ikime co mu gitondo, nk’igipfungu co mu gatondo kiyonga gihuye n’izuba, nk’umuguruka utumuka uva ku mbuga yo kugosorerako, nk’umwotsi usohoka uca mw’idirisha.
“Ariko namye ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu kuva aho mwaviriye muri Egiputa. Nta yindi Mana muzokwemera atari jewe, kuko ata Mukiza wundi atari jewe.
Narakwitwararitse uri mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu c’ubushuhe buturira.
Aho nabagaburira, barariye barahaga; bamaze guhaga, bafatwa n’ubwibone; maze baranyibagira.
Ni co gituma nzoba nk’intambwe kuri bo, nzobabundira nk’uko ingwe ibunda i ruhande y’inzira.
Nk’idubu ryibwe ibibuguru vyaryo, nzobatera, maze ndabatabagure; nzobashihagura nk’intambwe y’ingore, igikoko co mw’ishamba kizobatabagura.
Urahonye, yewe Isirayeli, kuko wigize umwansi wanje, jewe umutabazi wawe.
Umwami wawe ari hehe, kugira ngo agukize? Abatware bawe bo mu bisagara vyose vyawe bari hehe? Abo wansavye uvuga uti: ‘Mpa umwami n’abaganwa’?
Ico catumye ndaguha umwami nshavuye, kandi mu burake bwanje ndamutwara.
Ivyaha vya Efurayimu vyaregeranijwe, ivyaha vyiwe vyaranditswe birabikwa.
Uburibwe bubajeko nk’uko ibise biza ku mugore afise inda, ariko ni nk’umwana atagira ubwenge; igihe gishitse co kuvuka, ntazoshobora gusohoka ngo ave mu nda ya nyina.
Nzotabara aba bantu ndabakure mu kuzimu; nzobacungura ndabakure mu rupfu. Wa rupfu we, ivyago vyawe biri hehe? Kuzimu we, ubushobozi bwawe bwo kwica buri hehe? Sinzogira impuhwe,

Efurayimu naho yotera imbere hagati mu bavukanyi biwe. Umuyaga uvuye k’ Uhoraho uzoza uvuye i buseruko, uzohuha uturutse mu bugaragwa; isoko yabo izokama n’iriba ryaho ryume. Ububiko bwabo buzokwibwa ubutunzi burimwo bwose bunyagwe.
Abantu b’i Samariya bazobona inkurikizi z’ivyo bakoze, kuko bagararije Imana yabo. Bazokwicwa n’inkota; abana babo b’inzoya bazobasya babamenagurire hasi, abagore babo bibungenze bazofomozwa inkota.”
Nimugaruke k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu, yemwe Bisirayeli. Kuko ivyaha vyanyu ari vyo vyatumye mugwa!
Nimujane amajambo yanyu yo kwihana mugende k’ Uhoraho . Mumubwire muti: “Duharire ivyaha vyacu vyose maze utwakirane ubuntu, kugira ngo tugushikanire ivyimburwa vy’ishimwe bivuye mu kanwa kacu.

Ashuri ntibashobora kudukiza; canke kwurira amafarasi yacu y’intambara. Ntituzosubira kuvuga tuti: ‘Muri imana zacu,’ tubwira ivyo amaboko yacu yakoze, kuko muri wewe honyene ni ho impfuvyi zironka kugirirwa impuhwe.”
“Nzoharira ugusubira inyuma kwanyu kandi nzobakundisha umutima wanje wose, kuko uburake bwanje bubavuyeko.
Nzoba nk’ikime ku Bisirayeli; bazoshurika nk’ishurwe ryiza. Bazoshora imizi igere kure mw’ivu nk’igiti c’isederi c’i Libani
kandi imivyaro yabo izokura. Ubwiza bwabo buzoba nk’ubw’igiti c’umwelayo, ugutamirana kwabo kuzoba nk’ukw’isederi ry’i Libani.
Abantu bazosubira kuba musi y’igitutu ciwe; bazokura nk’ingano, bashurike nk’imizabibu, kumenyekana kw’Abisirayeli kuzoba nk’ukw’umuvinyu w’i Libani.
Efurayimu we, uracasangiye iki n’ibigirwamana? Nzomwishura kandi nzomwitaho. Nzoba nk’igiti c’isederi cama gitoshe; ivyamwa vyawe biva kuri jewe.”
Ni nde w’umunyabwenge? Natahure ibi bintu. Ni nde afise ubumenyi? Nabimenye. Inzira z’ Uhoraho ziragororotse; kandi umugororotsi azozigenderamwo, ariko abagarariji bazozitsitaramwo bagwe.
